raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

`MLAAttention.chunked_prefill_workspace_size` (`vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/mla_attention.py`) unconditionally called `MLACommonMetadataBuilder.determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size()` — the **dense** MLA sizing, `min(max(8 * max_model_len, 4 * max_num_seqs * block_size), 64K)` rounded up to the block size — regardless of which backend the layer actually runs on.

That value is used only during the profile run (`forward_impl`, `attn_metadata is None` branch) to allocate a worst-case
`torch.empty((workspace_size, num_heads, qk_nope_head_dim + v_head_dim))` that simulates the `kv_b_proj` up-projection performed by `_compute_prefill_context`.

Sparse MLA backends (DeepSeek-V3.2-style DSA: `FLASHMLA_SPARSE`, `FLASH_ATTN_MLA_SPARSE`, `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE` / `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM120`) build their metadata with `SparseMLACommonMetadataBuilder` (`vllm/model_executor/layers/attention/sparse_mla_attention.py`), which overrides `determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size` to cap the workspace at `max_num_seqs * index_topk` rows. Their `_project_kv` can therefore never see more context rows than that cap, yet the profile run reserved the dense worst case — and the KV cache was then sized against that inflated activation peak.

The fix asks the active backend for its own builder: `self.attn_backend.get_builder_cls()`, then `getattr(builder_cls, "determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size", MLACommonMetadataBuilder.determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size)`.

Builders defining the classmethod today (`grep -rn determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size vllm/`):

- `MLACommonMetadataBuilder` (dense MLA: `TRITON_MLA`, `FLASHMLA`, `FLASH_ATTN_MLA`, `CUTLASS_MLA`, `FLASHINFER_MLA`, ROCm/CPU MLA, …) — **unchanged**, same function as before.
- `SparseMLACommonMetadataBuilder` (the sparse backends above) — now actually used by the profile run.
- `XPUMLASparseMetadataBuilder` does not define it, so it keeps the dense sizing via the fallback (no behaviour change).

The change is hardware-agnostic: it is pure Python config arithmetic in the layer, with no kernel or device-specific code.

> Note: this PR was written with AI assistance (Claude Code); the change and all measurements below were reviewed and run by the submitter.

## Test Plan

- New unit tests in `tests/v1/attention/test_mla_context_chunks.py` (no GPU required):
  - `test_profile_workspace_follows_sparse_backend_cap` — a stub backend whose `get_builder_cls()` returns a `SparseMLACommonMetadataBuilder` subclass must make the property return the sparse cap.
  - `test_profile_workspace_keeps_dense_sizing` — `MLACommonMetadataBuilder` and a builder class without the classmethod both keep the dense sizing.
  - Run: `pytest tests/v1/attention/test_mla_context_chunks.py`
- End-to-end memory measurement on a real sparse-MLA (DSA) serve, comparing profile-run peak activation, available KV cache and GPU KV cache size before/after, plus an accuracy/behaviour check (GSM8K, MTP acceptance rate).
- `pre-commit` (ruff-format, ruff-check, SPDX, forbidden-imports, torch.cuda, boolean-context-manager hooks) on the changed files.

## Test Result

Unit tests (CPU, macOS):

```
pytest tests/v1/attention/test_mla_context_chunks.py
15 passed, 1 skipped
```

`ruff format` / `ruff check` on both changed files: clean. `mypy` reports no new findings in the changed lines (the file has pre-existing unrelated errors, unchanged at 36 before and after).

Sizing arithmetic for the measured configuration (GLM-5.3-Flash, `canada-quant/GLM-5.3-Flash-W4A16-MTP`: 64 attention heads, `qk_nope_head_dim = v_head_dim = 256`, `index_topk = 2048`, `--max-num-seqs 8`, `--max-model-len 32768`, KV block size 4352 — the model's KDA/mamba state forces that page alignment):

| | rows | profile allocation (bf16) |
|---|---|---|
| dense formula (before) | 69,632 (`8 * 32768` capped at 65,536, rounded up to 4352) | 69,632 x 64 x 512 x 2 B = **4.25 GiB** |
| sparse builder cap (after) | 16,384 (`8 * 2048`) | **1.00 GiB** |

A `torch.cuda.memory._record_memory_history` snapshot taken at the profile peak attributed **4.250 GiB** of the 4.5 GiB "peak activation" to this single allocation, at `mla_attention.py` in `forward_impl` (`unified_mla_attention_with_output` -> `forward_impl`).

End-to-end, before -> after:

| metric | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| peak activation per GPU | 4.52–4.60 GiB | 1.29–1.35 GiB |
| available KV cache (rank 0) | 9.84 GiB | 13.09 GiB (**+3.25 GiB**) |
| GPU KV cache size | 770,703 tokens | 1,102,315 tokens (**+43%**) |
| GSM8K | 0.98 | 0.98 |
| MTP acceptance | unchanged | unchanged |

Hardware tested: 4x NVIDIA CMP 170HX (GA100, sm_80, 64 GB), `--pipeline-parallel-size 4`, using an out-of-tree sm_80 sparse-attention backend whose builder subclasses `SparseMLACommonMetadataBuilder` (that backend is **not** part of this PR). The bug and the fix are in backend-agnostic layer code and apply equally to the in-tree sparse MLA backends on Hopper/Blackwell (`FLASHMLA_SPARSE`, `FLASH_ATTN_MLA_SPARSE`, `FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE`); a Hopper/Blackwell reproduction of the before/after KV cache numbers from a reviewer would be very welcome.

Dense MLA models are unaffected: the property resolves to exactly the same function it called before.

---

- [x] The test plan, such as providing test command.
- [x] The test results, such as pasting the results comparison before and after, or e2e results
- [x] (Optional) The necessary documentation update, such as updating `supported_models.md` and `examples` for a new model. — not applicable, no user-facing API or model support change.

@@ -9,12 +9,15 @@
 """
 
 from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
 
 import pytest
 import torch
 
 import vllm.utils.gpu_sync_debug as gsd
 from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.mla_attention import (
+    MLAAttention,
+    MLACommonMetadataBuilder,
     build_mla_chunked_context_metadata,
     init_mla_context_partial,
     reorg_kvcache,
@@ -353,3 +356,58 @@ def test_chunked_context_metadata_owns_context_lengths():
     context_lens.zero_()
     assert metadata is not None
     assert metadata.context_lens.tolist() == [16, 32]
+
+
+def _workspace_config(index_topk: int = 2048):
+    config = MagicMock()
+    config.model_config.max_model_len = 32768
+    config.model_config.hf_text_config.index_topk = index_topk
+    config.model_config.hf_config.index_topk = index_topk
+    config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs = 8
+    config.cache_config.block_size = 4352
+    config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size = 1
+    return config
+
+
+def _layer_with_backend(builder_cls, config):
+    layer = object.__new__(MLAAttention)
+    layer._vllm_config = config
+    layer._chunked_prefill_workspace_size = None
+    layer.attn_backend = SimpleNamespace(get_builder_cls=lambda: builder_cls)
+    return layer
+
+
+def test_profile_workspace_follows_sparse_backend_cap():
+    """A sparse backend must not profile the dense 64K workspace.
+
+    `_project_kv` on a sparse builder can never see more than
+    `max_num_seqs * index_topk` context rows, so reserving the dense
+    heuristic's rows during the profile run only steals KV cache space.
+    """
+    config = _workspace_config()
+
+    class SparseBuilder(SparseMLACommonMetadataBuilder):
+        pass
+
+    layer = _layer_with_backend(SparseBuilder, config)
+
+    assert layer.chunked_prefill_workspace_size == 8 * 2048
+    assert (
+        SparseMLACommonMetadataBuilder.determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size(config)
+        == 8 * 2048
+    )
+
+
+def test_profile_workspace_keeps_dense_sizing():
+    """Dense builders, and builders without the hook, keep the dense sizing."""
+    config = _workspace_config()
+    dense = MLACommonMetadataBuilder.determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size(config)
+
+    class BuilderWithoutHook:
+        pass
+
+    for builder_cls in (MLACommonMetadataBuilder, BuilderWithoutHook):
+        layer = _layer_with_backend(builder_cls, config)
+        assert layer.chunked_prefill_workspace_size == dense
+
+    assert dense > 8 * 2048

@@ -739,11 +739,20 @@ def bind_kv_cache(self, kv_cache: torch.Tensor) -> None:
     @property
     def chunked_prefill_workspace_size(self) -> int:
         if self._chunked_prefill_workspace_size is None:
-            self._chunked_prefill_workspace_size = (
-                MLACommonMetadataBuilder.determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size(
-                    self._vllm_config
-                )
-            )
+            # Ask the backend's own metadata builder: sparse MLA builders
+            # (`SparseMLACommonMetadataBuilder`, used by FLASHMLA_SPARSE /
+            # FLASH_ATTN_MLA_SPARSE / FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE) cap the workspace
+            # at `max_num_seqs * index_topk`, far below the dense 64K
+            # heuristic, and the profile run must not over-reserve for a chunk
+            # size the runtime can never produce. Builders that do not define
+            # the classmethod keep the dense sizing.
+            builder_cls = self.attn_backend.get_builder_cls()
+            determine = getattr(
+                builder_cls,
+                "determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size",
+                MLACommonMetadataBuilder.determine_chunked_prefill_workspace_size,
+            )
+            self._chunked_prefill_workspace_size = determine(self._vllm_config)
